name: Ocracoke
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Ocracoke?
answer_short: Yes, inside the village. Hyde County's ordinance, as the sheriff quotes it, allows a golf cart on public streets posted 35 mph or less. The driver must be at least 16. This map is the village only.

golf_cart.roads: Village streets posted 35 mph or less
golf_cart.notes: Driver at least 16; lights and a seat for each rider

rules.rule: Golf carts on public streets in Hyde County where the speed limit is 35 mph or less
No person under 16 may operate a golf cart on a public street
Registered, insured LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; may cross faster roads at intersections

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Ocracoke?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I take a golf cart up NC 12 to the ferry?
faq.a: This map covers the village. The highway north of the village is not in it.

faq.q: How old do you have to be to drive a golf cart in Ocracoke?
faq.a: At least 16, under the county statute the sheriff cites.
